events.body:
## Context

The README is 4 lines and describes a real-time collaboration tool with CVSS scoring. In practice `public/*.html` is a static prototype with demo data and `worker.py` isn't wired into `wrangler.toml`. Nothing says how to run or build it.

## What to do

1. Add Status (static prototype; API in `worker.py` not deployed yet), Run locally, Build CSS and Project layout sections.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README says what is live and what is planned
- [ ] Commands work as written

## How to test locally

```bash
Follow the README from a fresh clone.
```
